THEFLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT_STARTER_RELIC.d: At the start of combat, gain {ResiliencePower} Resilience.
THEFLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT_STARTER_RELIC.f: The beads are smooth where old vows wore them down.
THEFLAGELLANT-HALLOWED_ROSARY.title: Hallowed Rosary
THEFLAGELLANT-HALLOWED_ROSARY.descriptio: At the start of combat, gain {ResiliencePower} Resilience.
THEFLAGELLANT-HALLOWED_ROSARY.flavor: Every bead remembers a trial survived.
THEFLAGELLANT-DU_VU_DOLL.title: Du-Vu Doll
THEFLAGELLANT-DU_VU_DOLL.description: At the start of combat, gain 1 Strength for each Curse in your deck.
THEFLAGELLANT-DU_VU_DOLL.flavor: It smiles wider when the deck grows heavier.
THEFLAGELLANT-DARKSTONE_PERIAPT.title: Darkstone Periapt
THEFLAGELLANT-DARKSTONE_PERIAPT.descript: Whenever you add a permanent Curse to your deck, gain {MaxHp} Max HP.
THEFLAGELLANT-DARKSTONE_PERIAPT.flavor: A dark pulse answers every burden accepted.
THEFLAGELLANT-SCARLET_LETTER.title: Scarlet Letter
THEFLAGELLANT-SCARLET_LETTER.flavor: A mark made public loses none of its weight.
THEFLAGELLANT-QUILTED_VESTMENT.title: Quilted Vestment
THEFLAGELLANT-QUILTED_VESTMENT.descripti: For every {ResilienceThreshold} Resilience gained each combat, gain {Block} Block.
THEFLAGELLANT-QUILTED_VESTMENT.flavor: Layer upon layer, penance becomes protection.
THEFLAGELLANT-INQUISITORS_SEAL.title: Inquisitor's Seal
THEFLAGELLANT-INQUISITORS_SEAL.descripti: At the start of combat, apply {PenancePower} Penance to all enemies.
THEFLAGELLANT-INQUISITORS_SEAL.flavor: A stamped accusation needs no witness.
THEFLAGELLANT-BLOODIED_BANDAGES.title: Bloodied Bandages
THEFLAGELLANT-BLOODIED_BANDAGES.descript: Whenever you apply Penance, gain {Block} Block.
THEFLAGELLANT-STIGMATA.title: Stigmata
THEFLAGELLANT-STIGMATA.description: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {ResiliencePower} Resilience.
